```artifact
Feature: Prescription and Consultation Request Management

  Scenario: Ensuring a single prescription per consultation request
  Given a patient consultation request exists
  When the system generates a prescription
  Then the prescription should be mapped to the consultation request

  Scenario Outline:
    | Patient Consultation Request | Prescription |
    | Valid                      | Valid       |
    | Valid                      | Invalid     |
    | Invalid                     | Valid       |
    | Invalid                     | Invalid     |

  Given a chemist exists
  When the system assigns a prescription
  Then the prescription should be mapped to the chemist

  Scenario Outline:
    | Chemist | Prescription |
    | Valid                      | Valid       |
    | Valid                      | Invalid     |
    | Invalid                     | Valid       |
    | Invalid                     | Invalid     |

  Given a lab exists
  When the system assigns a prescription
  Then the prescription should be mapped to the lab

  Scenario Outline:
    | Lab | Prescription |
    | Valid                      | Valid       |
    | Valid                      | Invalid     |
    | Invalid                     | Valid       |
    | Invalid                     | Invalid     |

  Scenario: Ensuring a single prescription per chemist and lab
  Given a chemist exists
  When multiple prescriptions are assigned
  Then only one should be mapped to the chemist

  Given a lab exists
  When multiple prescriptions are assigned
  Then only one should be mapped to the lab

  Scenario Outline:
    | Chemist | Prescription |
    | Valid                      | Valid       |
    | Valid                      | Invalid     |
    | Invalid                     | Valid       |
    | Invalid                     | Invalid     |
    | Lab | Prescription |
    | Valid                      | Valid       |
    | Valid                      | Invalid     |
    | Invalid                     | Valid       |
    | Invalid                     | Invalid     |

  Scenario: Ensuring a single prescription per lab
  Given a lab exists
  When multiple prescriptions are assigned
  Then only one should be mapped to the lab

  Given a lab exists
  When multiple prescriptions are assigned
  Then only one should be mapped to the lab

  Scenario Outline:
    | Lab | Prescription |
    | Valid                      | Valid       |
    | Valid                      | Invalid     |
    | Invalid                     | Valid       |
    | Invalid                     | Invalid     |

  Scenario: Handling invalid prescription requests
  Given an invalid prescription request exists
  When the system processes the request
  Then the system should reject the request

  Scenario Outline:
    | Invalid Prescription Request | System Response |
    | Invalid                     | Rejected       |
    | Valid                      | Accepted       |

```
